# CG-AUTH-004: Security scheme changed incompatibly

A scheme's type, apiKey name/location, HTTP scheme or OpenID Connect URL changed.

**Why it matters:** Credentials are sent according to the scheme definition.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `securityScheme.changed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Security scheme "{scheme}" changed incompatibly ({fields}).
>
> Consumers send credentials the old way; the provider expects them differently. Used by: {operations}.
>
> **Fix:** Introduce a new scheme alongside the old one instead of changing it in place.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: apiKey header renamed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  security: [{key: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
+     key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Api-Token, in: header}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Security scheme "key" changed incompatibly (name).

### Fires: basic → bearer

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  security: [{h: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     h: {type: http, scheme: basic}
+     h: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Security scheme "h" changed incompatibly (scheme).

### Does not fire: bearerFormat only

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  security: [{bearer: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
+     bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-AUTH-004
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-AUTH-004: { severity: low }
```
